name: ai.itgrows.www/visibility
title: ItGrows — AI visibility
description: Does ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity recommend a business? Free check, prices, booking.

tools.name: check_ai_visibility
tools.description: Free check of a business website: works out five questions its buyers would ask an AI assistant (e.g. 'best dentist in Austin'), puts them to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity, and reports in how many answers the business is named and which competitors are named instead. Call it when a user asks whether ChatGPT or other assistants recommend their business, why a competitor shows up instead of them, or how visible they are in AI answers. Takes up to about a minute; a site checked in the last 24 hours returns at once. If it is still running when this call returns, call it again with the same site to get the result.

site.description: The business website, e.g. example.com or https://www.example.com

city.description: Optional: the city the business serves. The checker also reads it from the site.

niche.description: Optional: what the business does, e.g. 'orthodontist'. The checker also reads it from the site.

assistant.description: Which assistant is calling: chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity, copilot or other. Used only to mark the links you get back, so a visit that follows is attributed to you.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Current ItGrows prices in US dollars with direct payment links: Business plan ($499 a month + $499 setup, or $1,497 for 3 months) and Pro ($1,000 a month + $1,000 setup, or $3,000 for 3 months), what each includes, and that the detailed report is free. Call it when a user asks what ItGrows costs, compares plans, or wants to pay.

assistant.description: Which assistant is calling: chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity, copilot or other. Used only to mark the links you get back, so a visit that follows is attributed to you.

tools.name: book_call
tools.description: Request a 15-minute call with Kiryl, the founder of ItGrows (Pro starts after such a call). With an email, the request is delivered to the founder at once and he replies by email with times; without an email you get the contact page and address to pass to the user. Only call it with an email the user gave you for this purpose.

email.description: The user's email for the reply. Only with the user's consent.

message.description: What the user wants to discuss, and good times or time zone.

assistant.description: Which assistant is calling: chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity, copilot or other. Used only to mark the links you get back, so a visit that follows is attributed to you.

tools.name: get_sample_report
tools.description: A real example of the detailed ItGrows report (20 buyer questions × 4 assistants: every answer, who is named instead, which sites the assistants cite, and the plan), with a link to it and how to get one for your own site for free. Call it when a user wants to see what ItGrows delivers before paying.
